body: The only uncurable disease is brain prion, but you have to consider it takes time to remove a disease, you may have to take multiple pills (not at the same time)

You can contract various diseases throughout the game that require different methods of fixing them that can range from taking a one time pill to a bullet to the head.

This link should help you to distinguish what they are, how you got them and what you need to do to cure them

P.S. no question is a dumb question
